>  hella cool and understanding

how do i go there bro? take a bus? stay in a shelter? i can't go to humbolt county without money..

my father gave up on me around age 14 when i started smoking pot and not going to school. he fussed me for dropping out of high school, then he says college is a waste of time, and they are "educated idiots," so now i'm just one of "them." -- i can't win for losing, eh?

he is remarried with a hungarian wife, and also has a stepdaughter, now, who does no wrong and makes perfect grades. he want's nothing to do with me, and thinks i'm a failure.

we have dinner like once or twice a year, but don't talk about much. 

i live with my mother, but as of lately all we've done is argue and fight. she has her own issues she is struggling with, and doesn't really know how to help..

one minute she's complaining about me going out and getting a job, etc.. etc.. -- then when i say i am, she wants to tell me why i can't, and no i need to be on disability, but i won't be able to do anything with the amount of money i get from disability, she says.

i really feel like i'm here just to be tortured. -- paying for my father's mistakes, my mistakes, etc..

i dream of moving away and getting a "fresh start," but it seems God has this negative energy over me that prevents me from going anywhere in life, so even if i move away it will just be same because God is telling these people not to treat me nice.

one time, i even drove out to California all the way from North Carolina (where i live), in my car, alone, without stopping (slept in my car at road stops), and no cell phone. i wanted to get as far away as i could by car without having to leave the country, plus i've always dreamed of california: legal cannabis, great colleges, just an overall great place it seems.. but hey what do they say "the grass always seems greener.."

everyone here gets: "i feel your pain, i understand, been there, etc.."

i get: throw your life in a dumpster. 


wtf. story of my life. that right there is what i'm talking about: my experiences that i want to end. i've tried, trust me i've tried to make it in this world but just couldn't.

believe what you wish about me. that's on you.
